# DAFZA Warehouse D-20

> Warehouse D-20 is a storage and light-industrial unit inside Dubai Airport Freezone, the customs-bonded business park on the northern edge of Dubai International Airport. The free zone hosts thousands of companies and is used heavily for air-freight logistics, electronics, pharmaceuticals and aviation supply, with its warehousing laid out in numbered blocks close to the cargo terminals. The unit provides covered storage with associated office and loading space.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Dubai Airport Freezone, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

Warehouse D-20 is a warehouse unit within the Dubai Airport Freezone (DAFZA), the free zone adjoining Dubai International Airport. MENASCO executed the MEP works for the warehouse, providing the mechanical, electrical and plumbing services for the unit and coordinating their installation with the building works.
